# Inmobiliaria Grande

Inmobiliaria Grande is a family-run real-estate agency in Granada, Spain, founded in 1970 and
still at Calle Recogidas 13. This is its static website: homes for sale and to rent in Granada
city and province (Monachil, Pulianas, La Malahá, Cogollos de la Vega), a free valuation
service for sellers, and a Spanish/English interface.

Key facts:
- Address: Calle Recogidas 13, 1.º A, 18008 Granada
- Phone: +34 958 25 24 61 (office landline)
- WhatsApp / mobile: +34 622 350 918
- Email: info@inmobiliariagrande.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday 9:30–14:00 and 17:00–20:30; closed Saturday and Sunday
- Founded: 1970

Main pages (Spanish):
- https://www.inmobiliariagrande.com/
- https://www.inmobiliariagrande.com/inmuebles.html (all listings, filters, favourites)
- https://www.inmobiliariagrande.com/vende-tu-casa.html (valuation in 48 h, list your property)
- https://www.inmobiliariagrande.com/sobre-nosotros.html (history, team)
- https://www.inmobiliariagrande.com/contacto.html

English:
- https://www.inmobiliariagrande.com/en/
- https://www.inmobiliariagrande.com/en/properties.html
- https://www.inmobiliariagrande.com/en/sell-your-home.html
- https://www.inmobiliariagrande.com/en/contact.html

Each listing has its own page under /inmuebles/ (Spanish) and /en/properties/ (English) with
schema.org RealEstateListing markup. The site is plain HTML + CSS + one small vanilla JS file.
